counter: src/orders.js: `if (value === '' || (isOrderId && value === 'NONE')) continue;` prevents empty-value nodes; `if (nodes.length > 0) messages.push({ number, nodes });` means only identifier-bearing messages form groups; the replay loop `for (const { isOrderId, value } of nodes) { (isOrderId ? group.orderIds : group.clOrdIds).add(value); }` accumulates ids from all grouped messages including ExecutionReports; `findOrder` returns a group only when `clOrdIds.includes(id) || orderIds.includes(id)`.
